text:
European football enters another busy week headlined by Barcelona hosting Real Madrid, following a round filled with unexpected scorelines across the top five leagues.

The clearest value opportunity on the board comes in La Liga, where Levante take on Athletic Bilbao. Bet365 prices a Levante victory at 3.4, implying roughly a 29.4% probability, whereas the model estimates their winning chance at 46.7%, generating an expected value of 49.9%. While the model has been slightly less accurate than the bookmakers over time, wide gaps like this make the fixture worth a closer look.

The previous round produced several sharp upsets that tested predictive accuracy, with Bet365 generally handling the chaos better. In Serie A, Venezia's 1-0 stunner against Napoli proved the model's biggest misstep, generating a log loss of 2.258—where lower represents better accuracy—after giving Napoli a 72.9% chance to win. The model also misread the Bundesliga thriller between Elversberg and Augsburg, assigning the visitors a 63.9% chance only for Elversberg to win 4-3, logging a 1.792 loss compared to Bet365's 0.966.

Even so, the model notched notable successes. It anticipated Osasuna's 2-0 victory over Santander far more assertively than the market, backing the hosts at 66% and posting a much lower log loss of 0.415 to Bet365's 0.74. In Ligue 1, it also found the mark decisively by handing Lens a 67.6% chance to triumph at Troyes, finishing with a 0.392 log loss against the bookmaker's 0.667.
